when-the-crab-changes-locations.text: The gemstone crab burrows away, leaving a piece of its shell behind.
The top three crab crushers were [player 1], [player 2], & [player 3]!
If the player was among the 16 players who dealt the most damage:

steps.text: You gained enough understanding of the crab to mine from its remains.

mining-the-crab-s-shell.text: If the player was among the 16 players who dealt the most damage:

steps.text: The player has a pickaxe they can use:
You swing your pick at the crab shell.
You mine an uncut [gem] from the crab shell.
The player doesn't have a pickaxe:
You need a pickaxe to mine the shell. You do not have a pickaxe which you have the Mining level to use.

mining-the-crab-s-shell.text: If the player did not deal enough damage:

steps.text: Your understanding of the gemstone crab is not great enough to mine its shell.
